decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach: left to left wooden car, right to nearer camera. Plan cars in blue, cameras in red, pens in white; initial lifts and gradual wrist pitch.
Pitch both grippers toward tabletop while staying above objects; next align jaws with narrow object dimensions.
Yaw jaws across car and camera widths, compensating link6-to-finger offset. Remain high for clearance.
Descend toward left car and near right camera, refining image-based centering. Keep jaws open until contact height is checked.
Complete short descent, close on car and camera, then test-lift both to verify retention from wrist views.
Both objects appear retained. Lift above basket rims and begin moving left car toward blue and right camera toward red without crossing arms.
Left car slipped back onto table; reopen and approach it lower. Right camera remains visibly held, so carry into red basket and start controlled lowering.
Retry corrected tensor from unchanged observation: open right over red then clear toward remaining camera; align left car from wrist image.
Left car now centered between jaws: close and make a small retention lift. Right approach remaining camera with open jaws, adjusting yaw and lowering cautiously.
Left grasp appears too high, with jaws closing above the car. Reopen, lower both wrists to engage object sides, and close at the lower height.
Side contact now visible on both objects. Lift vertically with fully closed targets, then start moving toward blue and red while watching for slippage.
Right camera visibly retained; transport over red. Left car remained on table: correct grasp center backward and left, reopen and descend for a centered side grasp.
Align left jaws with car body axis before closing at side height. Lower second camera inside red and open, then begin clearing the basket.
Left jaws still appear to close above the car; reopen and lower another 28 mm with a small centering correction, then test lift. Right clears red and approaches the right car.
Left car now visibly engaged between jaw sides; lift vertically before transport. Right aligns over the remaining car and descends toward the successful lower side-grasp height.
Left car is visibly suspended, albeit rotated; carry gently to left side of blue. Shift right jaws toward car center, lower to side height, close and test lift.
Replan after rejected suffix: smaller left increments with a gradual descent to avoid large elbow changes while entering blue. Right aligns yaw, closes on car sides, and tests retention.
Correct malformed row; same unchanged observation. Withdraw left from failed approach and lift right car before basket transport.
Use sub-millimeter initial withdrawal to escape left near-singular elbow configuration without discontinuity. Right retains closed target while lifting car.
Approach flipped left car again at its new table position. Right car visibly held: move toward blue while turning approach forward to avoid the previous near-singular basket reach.
Left approach appears obstructed near basket wall; withdraw slightly, narrow opening, and make wrist more vertical. Right transports retained car to blue's right half.
Refine left flipped-car grasp using wrist centering, then close and test lift. Advance right car safely past blue's front rim while maintaining closed grip.
Test left-car retention with a vertical lift before transporting. Lower and release right car inside blue, then clear right arm outward to keep the center unobstructed.
Right car is settled in blue; retract right arm. Left car again slipped, so correct along its length using wrist view and approach with open jaws before another side grasp.
Retry corrected row from unchanged state: left longitudinal centering at fixed height, right retreat with gradual wrist relaxation.
Continue left alignment along car centerline, avoiding adjacent pen, then short descent. Return right near origin with smooth pose interpolation.
Correct invalid row from unchanged observation. Center car in pinch region, close, and test short vertical lift with right arm stationary.
Car appears pinched at its side. Lift slowly while biasing the approach forward and withdrawing link6 slightly to preserve elbow configuration before entering blue.
Car slipped from an end grasp. Reapproach its body center, using head projection to correct about 25 mm left, with near-vertical wrist and open jaws.
Wrist view shows car offset to the right of the jaws. Correct toward table-front and slightly along its length, then descend 16 mm and close on the body.
Tracking residual indicates contact obstruction. Lift clear before lateral repositioning rather than dragging fingers through the basket edge or car.
Now clear of obstruction, descend over the projected car center with narrowed open jaws and a small yaw alignment. Check geometry before closure.
Shift jaws laterally from adjacent pen onto the car's narrow side, lower to side contact height, then close without lifting yet.
Current pinch spans car edge and adjacent pen. Reopen and lift clear, then shift to the car center estimated from head projection rather than dragging either object.
Car remains awkwardly on its side near the rim. Clear that area and first approach the unobstructed white pen for the white category basket.
Descend toward white pen with small lateral centering corrections; keep open until its shaft is in the pinch region.
White pen shaft is between jaws. Lower to tabletop-side contact height, refine centering and close.
White pen appears gripped along its shaft. Lift clear of table and begin moving toward white basket, holding fully closed.
White pen remained on table after lift. Reapproach its shaft with a lower pinch height and narrower opening, using updated visible position.
At tabletop height with white shaft centered: close, allow settling, and make a short vertical retention test before any lateral transport.
White pen is visibly retained after test lift. Gently raise and transport toward white basket with closed grip and fixed orientation.
Carry retained white pen fully over white basket before lowering; keep motion smooth and jaws closed.
Lower white pen into white basket and release. Clear the rim before moving toward the remaining black pen.
White pen is visibly inside white basket. Approach black pen above its shaft using the same successful downward grasp orientation.
Move pinch toward middle of black pen shaft, narrow jaws to avoid neighboring car, descend to proven pen grasp height and close.
Black shaft ended left of pinch center. Reopen and shift laterally 12 mm, close again at same proven height and test a short lift.
Black pen stays fixed in wrist image during lift, suggesting retention despite off-center appearance. Raise clear and carry gently toward white basket.
Black pen did not remain retained. Replan from visible table location, correcting grasp laterally toward its center before a lower closure.
Neighboring car obstructs mid-shaft approach. Shift pinch toward exposed pen tip, lower cautiously, close and test a few millimeters of lift.
Car and pen overlap at pinch point. Lift straight slowly to identify which object is retained before committing to any category basket.
Car is visibly retained while black pen stays on table. Raise car above blue rim and gently tilt approach forward to preserve elbow margin during placement.
Car remains securely visible in jaws. Move entirely over blue's left interior, then begin lowering while keeping grasp closed.
Lower retained car into blue's interior, release, and begin a small vertical clearance lift. Verify it settles before returning for black pen.
Both cars now visible inside blue. Clear its rim and approach the unobstructed black pen, restoring near-vertical grasp orientation.
Black pen is to the right of pinch center. Correct laterally during slow descent and align yaw, keeping jaws open until shaft centering is confirmed.
Descent amplified lateral error; pen is now left of jaws. Recenter 16 mm at low height with open jaws, then close and pause before lift.
Pen was pushed outside left jaw. Lift open before lateral recentering to avoid dragging it, then descend vertically with wide jaws; inspect before closing.
Black shaft is now between open jaws. Close at tabletop height without further lateral dragging, pause, then test a 24 mm vertical lift.
Black pen is centered and visibly retained after lift. Raise above basket rims and carry toward white basket, keeping grasp closed and orientation fixed.
Black pen remains retained. Translate it fully over white basket interior at rim-clearance height before releasing.
Lower black pen inside white basket and release alongside white pen; start clearing the basket before return to origin.
All six objects are now visible in category baskets. Clear left fingers above white rim, retract and smoothly unwind toward origin; fine-correct parked right arm.
Pens, cars and cameras are separated and settled in white, blue and red. Continue smooth left-arm retreat toward origin with open grippers and fine-correct right orientation.
Complete left-arm return toward its initial pose with decreasing retreat increments and gradual orientation restoration; both grippers remain open.
